messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync request — we need to lock embargo windows + SI oncall for the upcoming H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi coordinated announcements. Main asks: compatibility signoffs, PSIRT check, marketplace listing readiness, and SI oncall coverage. Can we pick checkpoints this week?
Mike: What target dates are we leaning to? Partners mentioned mid–May availability for H200, but marketing prefers late–May for press. Any constraints from infra?
Jordan: From runtime side: H100/H200 build is stable on our 2.1 kernel. MI300 still on validation for quant kernels — I need ~72 hours of perf regression runs (preferably on Dedicated). Gaudi has a kernel driver change queued; waiting on vendor patch.
Sara: Marketing needs 72h embargo window for press assets + embargo list finalized. Also need clear pre-brief cutoffs to avoid leaks. Can partners commit to sharing final specs by Tue EOD?
Eddy: Lab capacity update: we can run the SI smoke suite on Dedicated pool Wed/Thu (we've reserved slots). Need exact firmware+driver versions to pin the runs. Quick test command for SI smoke:
```
ssh si-runner@lab
./run_si_smoke.sh --model=h100,h200,mi300,gaudi --image=redwood/inference:canary
```
Jordan: I'll open a short PR with the compatibility checklist. Items: image(s), kernel+driver tags, quant profile, perf bench results, SI smoke runbook, marketplace SKU metadata, rollback plan.
Vinod: FYI — vendor asks: NVIDIA prefers embargo start May 20 00:00 PT -> end May 24 23:59 PT. Gaudi partner suggests May 22 start. If we try a single start date we might lose alignment with one partner. Thoughts on stagger vs single window?
Sara: Staggered press could work but we'll need unified messaging doc and a clear embargo handoff timeline. Also: we'll ask partners to pre-brief 3 top tier outlets 48h before our public window. SI oncall: we need M–F 9–5 coverage the week of each partner announce, with escalation into eng-oncall.
Alyssa: Proposed operational checkpoints: T-7: Tech signoff (internal), T-4: Vendor driver check (final patch in), T-3: SI dry-run on Dedicated, T-2: Embargo handshake with partners, T-1: Partner oncall confirmed + press assets locked. If we agree, I’ll send invites.
Mike: I agree. I'll create calendar invites and an ops playbook doc. @Eddy please own lab booking and the smoke run scheduling.
Eddy: Lab slots booked for the proposed dry-run. Added runbook link to the calendar invite. One blocker: Gaudi driver patch hasn't landed; vendor claims it's in next commit. If it slips past T-4, we should have a fallback variant using B200 (same messaging but different performance callouts).
Alyssa: Good catch. Add fallback rule: if Gaudi driver not present by T-4, swap Gaudi calls to B200 variant in the embargo materials & marketplace metadata. I'll draft fallback messaging and share w/ partners.
Jordan: I'll add a quick compatibility table in the PR indicating which features are gated by the Gaudi driver (KV cache perf, certain quant paths). That will make the fallback decision deterministic.
Vinod: I'll confirm vendor embargo windows and get explicit permission for pre-brief lists. Also pinged SI partners to confirm oncall rosters.
Sara: Once partners confirm windows, marketing will prepare the embargo list + press assets and set the pre-brief invites.
Alyssa: Thanks everyone — action items: Jordan PR + checklist, Eddy lab ownership, Vinod partner confirmations, Mike ops invites, Sara press assets. I'll follow up with partners after T-7 tech signoff.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary deploy for the embargo assets is scheduled for 2760010000; if any failures surface please alert #eng-oncall and tag @Jordan and @Eddy.
